description: Security advisories for one open-source package version (npm, PyPI, Go, Maven, crates.io, NuGet, RubyGems, Packagist, Pub, Hex...). Returns a verdict (vulnerable yes/no, vuln count, max severity, max CVSS v3 score, counts by severity, recommended upgrade version re-checked against OSV, latest stable version and whether it is affected) plus every advisory: OSV/GHSA id, CVE aliases, summary, severity label, CVSS v3 score (computed from the vector) and v4 vector, affected ranges, fixed versions, the fix for this version, published/modified dates and references. Duplicate records (GHSA vs PYSEC/GO ids with the same CVE) are merged. Also returns the version's licenses, publish date, deprecation and dependency counts from deps.dev. Omit version to check the latest stable release. Vulnerability data from OSV.dev (CC-BY 4.0); package metadata from deps.dev. Unknown packages/versions, bad input and upstream errors are not charged. Costs $0.003 USDC per call via x402.

ecosystem.description: Package ecosystem: npm, PyPI, Go, Maven, crates.io, NuGet, RubyGems, Packagist, Pub, Hex, CRAN, Hackage, SwiftURL, ConanCenter (aliases like pip, cargo, gem, composer accepted)
